IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Sunday 8 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning south to southeasterly in the late morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.

Monday 9 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming east to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots in the middle of the day then tending north to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, decreasing below 0.5 metres during the morning, then increasing to around 1 metre around midday.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Tuesday 10 November
Winds: North to northwesterly about 10 knots becoming southeasterly during the day then tending southeast to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Becoming cloudy.

Wednesday 11 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending westerly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system will drift eastwards across the state today, and away to the southeast from Monday. A trough is expected to move over from the west on Tuesday evening, closely followed by a ridge on Wednesday.
